# Animated Grid Pattern

npm install clsx@2.1.1 motion@13.4.0 react@19.3.0 react-dom@19.3.0 tailwind-merge@3.7.0

npm install -D tailwindcss@4 @tailwindcss/postcss@4 postcss

Use a React + TypeScript project. Set up Tailwind CSS v4 with the @tailwindcss/postcss plugin (or @tailwindcss/vite for Vite). Copy these files keeping their relative paths. Import registry/demo.css once in your app. It contains Tailwind sources, theme tokens, and keyframes required by the example. Place public/media assets at /media on your server. The .dark class on the html element activates dark variants.

App.tsx is a working example; registry/demos/animated-grid-pattern.tsx shows the component API. The DemoFrame helper only controls the example layout. You may remove it when integrating the component. Keep the copyright notices and the included license files.

Original source: https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui/blob/d7207e5692d14c00dceafa8488d6d01f197fa0e4/apps/www/registry/magicui/animated-grid-pattern.tsx
Pinned revision: d7207e5692d14c00dceafa8488d6d01f197fa0e4

The catalog changed module paths, replaced Next.js-only adapters with plain React, and replaced sample media with local vector artwork. The examples include small accessibility, React 19, and demo behavior fixes. Original component visual styles are retained.
